poses.label: planted-neutral
poses.trigger: initial settled Builder pose, before any action
limits: Discrete sampled production-rig poses only; no continuous motion or exhaustive all-object collision test.
Proper segment/triangle crossings only; coplanar contact and full containment are not detected.
Same-owner guard/link embedding and same-owner talon-root intersections are reported as intentional/attachment-review categories, not treated as failures.
Frame and edge targets are parent-batched GLB meshes; frame crossing attribution is to the owner-batched frame assembly, not an isolated source link mesh.
